title: KrishiSaathi
highlights: Built a full-stack marketplace platform connecting farmers directly with buyers, eliminating agricultural middlemen for 18,300+ commodity price records.
Developed an ARIMA-based machine learning model trained on AGMARKNET government mandi price data to forecast commodity prices.
Engineered a hybrid Firestore and MongoDB persistence architecture with real-time cart synchronization and role-based farmer and buyer dashboards.
Integrated Google, Facebook, and Apple OAuth with Razorpay payments and 8-language commodity search; reduced bundle size 69% (2.9MB → 900KB) via code splitting.
Filed for copyright registration with the Indian Copyright Office (Diary No. SW-21662/2026-CO), currently in re-scrutiny.
problem: Indian farmers lose 25–40% of revenue to middlemen in traditional mandi (market) systems. No direct-to-buyer digital platform existed that combined real-time market price intelligence with a streamlined e-commerce flow for agricultural commodities.
approach: Built a full-stack marketplace with a price-prediction engine trained on government data. Designed a hybrid database architecture combining Firestore's real-time sync with MongoDB's flexibility for complex commodity queries. Implemented role-based dashboards for farmers and buyers with multi-language search support.
architecture: Hybrid Firestore + MongoDB architecture — Firestore handles real-time cart sync and user sessions, while MongoDB manages the commodity catalog and price history. ARIMA-based price prediction model trained on 18,300+ rows of AGMARKNET government mandi data. React frontend with code-split routes, Node.js/Express API layer, Razorpay payment integration, and OAuth via Google/Facebook/Apple.

title: MedTalk – AI Healthcare Chatbot
highlights: Developed a 24/7 multilingual AI chatbot using the Google Gemini API with voice-based interaction (Google Cloud Speech-to-Text / Text-to-Speech).
Built a secure Flask REST backend for preliminary healthcare guidance with robust query resolution.
Integrated natural language understanding to deliver accessible healthcare guidance across languages.
features: Clinical query reasoning via Google Gemini API
problem: Healthcare access in multilingual regions is limited by language barriers and the unavailability of medical professionals around the clock. Patients need reliable, accessible preliminary health guidance at any hour.
approach: Built a voice-enabled AI chatbot powered by Google's Gemini API for medical query understanding, with Google Cloud Speech-to-Text and Text-to-Speech for multilingual voice interactions. Designed a secure RESTful backend with Flask, focusing on response accuracy and patient data privacy.
architecture: Python/Flask backend serving a RESTful API. Google Gemini API handles natural language understanding and medical response generation. Google Cloud STT/TTS enables voice input and audio output in multiple languages. Secure session management and input sanitization throughout.

title: IMDB Movie Review Sentiment
description: NLP Sentiment Classifier for 50,000 IMDB Reviews
highlights: Built an NLP sentiment classifier for 50,000 IMDB reviews using TF-IDF feature extraction.
Evaluated Logistic Regression, Naïve Bayes, and Bidirectional LSTM models on accuracy and F1-score.
Implemented comprehensive text preprocessing and comparative performance evaluation.
features: Multi-model comparison: Logistic Regression, Naïve Bayes, Bidirectional LSTM
problem: Understanding user feedback at scale is a common challenge for digital platforms. Manual review classification is inefficient and error-prone, requiring automated natural language understanding pipelines to accurately determine sentiment in movie reviews.
approach: Developed an end-to-end NLP and machine learning pipeline to preprocess raw IMDB text data, extract TF-IDF features, and train supervised classifiers. Conducted extensive hyperparameter tuning and model evaluation using accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score alongside confusion matrices and word clouds.
architecture: Python-driven NLP pipeline utilizing NLTK for tokenization, stop-word removal, and lemmatization. TF-IDF vectorization for text representation. Model suite includes Scikit-learn (Logistic Regression, Naive Bayes, SVM) and TensorFlow/Keras neural network models for binary classification.
